name: dockdo
description: Self-hosted dockerized Todo app with separate admin dashboard

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dockdo/shared && npm run build:server -w @dockdo/app && npm run build:web -w @dockdo/app && npm run build:server -w @dockdo/admin && npm run build:web -w @dockdo/admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,app,admin,web-app,web-admin -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @dockdo/shared" "npm run dev:server -w @dockdo/app" "npm run dev:server -w @dockdo/admin" "npm run dev:web -w @dockdo/app" "npm run dev:web -w @dockdo/admin"
